reviews.title: fits Optiplex SFF
reviews.comment: Cools my Dell Optiplex 3060 just fine. I'm using this computer as a non-intensive homelab server that's been running 24/7 for a few weeks now since install. Again, it's been working fine with no issues. This new cooler is also fairly smaller than the OEM unit, which allows me to creatively fit in an additional SSD.
reviews.author: Justin Fern

reviews.title: Works as well as stock cooler even with reduced size for small case
reviews.comment: I got this cooler to replace a stock AMD cooler that would no longer fit when I was transferring my setup into a cramped 2U case. The stock cooler was just too tall to fit. I can't speak to it's suitability to a high demand gaming rig, but there was no loss of cooling ability after downsizing to this cooler. Core temps before and after the move seemed about the same under any of the moderate demand uses I typically encounter. Another feature I didn't anticipate liking was the lack of illumination. I know most people pay extra for the RGB so lots of manufacturers are including it as a bonus feature, but I'm old school and just want my system to work unnoticed. And even when you use the software to turn the lights off, eventually a power cycle or glitch eventually turns them back on by default. For me, the nice dark case not flashing "hey look over here" was a bonus.
reviews.author: Donald Shockley

reviews.title: Great for SFF builds!
reviews.comment: Man this thing is cool! (No pun intended). It's exceptionally well made, seems super simple to install, and it's nice and compact for your SFF needs. I won't be using this to cool my 5900X, but it will be responsible for cooling my 5600GT in my upcoming SFF build. I think when compared to the big names, the value for money here rock solid for what you get; and this thing packs enough punch to cool a lower TDP CPU just fine in an otherwise tight space. Overall? ID did it again. 5/5 from me!
reviews.author: Logan Campbell
